body.title: Check the fix end to end on a rebuilt daemon (reported by the builder)
body.summary: Rebuild the daemon and restart it, then with it running create mkdir -p dir/sub with a small .ts file at once and another file three seconds later, and see both indexed without a restart; then edit an already indexed file and see it fresh. The build gate cannot run this, so the builder reports the result with the codeReview.freshness replies as evidence.
acceptanceChecks: codeReview.freshness reports a file written at once into a directory created with mkdir -p as not stale within seconds, and the file written three seconds later too, with no restart in between
An edit of an already indexed file is reported fresh after the gate's request
The reply of each check is quoted in the report

tests.name: Reported by the builder, not run by the gate: with the rebuilt daemon running, create mkdir -p dir/sub with a small .ts file in it at once, then another file three seconds later, and see both indexed (codeReview.freshness reports them not stale) without a restart; then edit an already indexed file and see it fresh
